dct_title_s: Geographic mapping of school locations in the Pacific
dct_description_sm: Schools in all Pacific Island Countries and Territories have been included in their respective Education Management Information Systems in 2015 by the Statistics for Development Division of SPC. This data can be used for applications such as disaster mitigation and optimise emergency response and service delivery. _Access this dataset from the [Pacific Data Hub](https://pacificdata.org/data/dataset/geographic-mapping-of-school-locations-in-the-pacific)_
